title: Native dialogs & modals
summary: Accept a native confirm() to delete a team member, and drive an in-page modal dialog.
why: Playwright auto-dismisses native dialogs (alert/confirm/prompt) unless you handle them — a classic 'works manually, fails in automation' trap. Modals, on the other hand, are normal DOM you scope with getByRole('dialog').
objectives: Register page.once('dialog', d => d.accept()) before clicking Delete
Assert 'Deleted Ana' and that Ana's row is gone
Open Settings, tick the checkbox inside the dialog, Save, and assert the dialog closes
pitfalls: Registering the dialog handler after the click — the dialog has already been dismissed.
Asserting only the status text: a delete that doesn't remove the row slips through.
teachAlong: Cause: without a handler Playwright dismisses confirm().
Effect: the app reads 'Cancel' and keeps Ana.
Gate: a planted bug keeps the row after delete — check the row really disappears.

requires.reason: Handle the native confirm(): page.once('dialog', (dialog) => dialog.accept()) before clicking Delete.

mutants.reason: confirming a delete does not remove the row
the Settings dialog Save button does nothing

wrongSolutions.label: no dialog handler
